name: PutMeOn
source:
This visual novel tells the story of a brother and sister who create an app and a website for their small clothing store, which no one knows yet, but everything is not so easy, a virus changes their plans, who or what wants to prevent them, will have to find out... keep in mind that your choices determine each character's relationship, which can play a role in the game!

[Edited from [url=https://stafilynx.itch.io/putmeon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说讲述了一对兄弟姐妹为他们的小服装店创建一个应用程序和一个网站的故事，目前还没有人知道，但一切并不那么容易，病毒改变了他们的计划，谁或什么想要阻止他们，必须找出答案……记住，你的选择决定了每个角色的关系，这可以在游戏中发挥作用！

[编辑自[url=https://stafilynx.itch.io/putmeon]Itch.io[/url]]
